thread:
eli: Quick sync request - PM wants a tiny "cost sandbox" on route pages: pick X% reroute to a cheaper model variant, toggle prefetch, and get instant cost + latency delta before creating a canary. Feasible?
sam: Yes. Inputs needed: per-model per-route 1m rollups: token_count, cache_hits, seq_len_bucket_fracs (4 buckets), p50/p95. Keep tenant off to limit cardinality.
toni: Agree. Emitter names: router.tokens{model,route}, router.cache_hits{model,route}, router.seq_hist{model,route}. MV recompute every 3-5m.
meera: API sketch: POST /internal/sim/route_quick {model,alt_model,route,reroute_pct,window_mins,cache_override?}. Response minimal: cost_delta, latency_delta, est_tokens, ci, top_drivers.
ux-zoe: UI: inline compact control - slider + prefetch toggle. Show three numbers and a small "Explain" chevron. Add CTA "apply to canary" prefill. Show confidence band.
sam: MVP: read last-5m MV and extrapolate; full accuracy needs longer MV + daily validation. Monitor sim_error and surface drift.
eli: Security: gate to platform admins/beta orgs. Redact exact counts unless org owns data.
infra-bot: created task CS-7788 assigned to sam/toni. CI job queued. :gear:
meera: I'll post proto + example payload/response by EOD. Bonius: keep math simple initially (per-bucket tokens * per-token-price * (1-cache_credit)).
eli: thanks — will coordinate PM acceptance and beta list. :thumbsup:
